bump into an old friend: While shopping at the night market last weekend, I happened to bump into an old friend from junior high.
上週末逛夜市時，我碰巧巧遇了一位國中時的老友。
bump up prices: Because the cost of eggs has gone up, many bakeries have had to bump up prices for their cakes.
因為雞蛋成本上漲，許多麵包店不得不調高蛋糕的價格。
bump someone off the list: The airline overbooked the flight and had to bump someone off the list of passengers.
航空公司超賣了機位，不得不把某位乘客從名單中剔除。
a bumpy road: The bus moved slowly along a bumpy road in the mountains, and several passengers felt sick.
巴士沿著山區的顛簸之路緩慢前進，好幾位乘客感到不舒服。
bury oneself in work: After his girlfriend left him, he tried to forget her by burying himself in work every night.
女友離開他之後，他每晚埋首工作，試圖忘了她。
bury the hatchet: After not speaking for two years, the two sisters decided to bury the hatchet at their mother's birthday party.
兩年沒說話後，兩姊妹決定在母親的生日派對上言歸於好。
bury one's feelings: He was taught to bury his feelings as a child, so now he finds it hard to say when he is sad.
他小時候被教導要壓抑情感，所以現在他很難說出自己難過。
bury one's head in the sand: You cannot bury your head in the sand and hope your debt will disappear; you need a plan to pay it back.
你不能逃避現實，指望債務自己消失；你需要一個還款計畫。
buzz with activity: The night before the festival, the whole village was buzzing with activity as people hung lanterns and cooked.
節慶前一晚，整個村莊熱鬧非凡，大家忙著掛燈籠和煮飯。
the phone buzzed: In the middle of the quiet exam, the phone buzzed in someone's bag, and the teacher looked up angrily.
在安靜的考試中，有人包包裡的手機震動，老師生氣地抬起頭來。
buzz with excitement: The stadium began to buzz with excitement as the famous singer walked onto the stage.
當那位知名歌手走上舞台時，體育場開始興奮騷動起來。
create a buzz: The new phone created a buzz on social media weeks before it was even available in stores.
這款新手機在店裡上市好幾週前，就已在社群媒體上引發話題。
calculate the risk: Before investing all your savings in one company, you should carefully calculate the risk of losing it.
在把所有積蓄投資在一家公司之前，你應該仔細計算賠錢的風險。
a calculated move: Lowering ticket prices before the holiday was a calculated move to attract more young customers.
在假期前調降票價是精心盤算的一步，目的是吸引更多年輕顧客。
calculate the cost: Before we buy a car, let's calculate the cost of gas, insurance, and parking for a whole year.
在買車之前，我們先計算一整年的油錢、保險和停車費的成本。
campaign for equal rights: For many years, she campaigned for equal rights so that women could receive the same pay as men.
多年來，她為平權奔走，讓女性能領到和男性相同的薪水。
campaign against pollution: Students at our school started to campaign against pollution by asking shops to stop using plastic bags.
我們學校的學生發起反污染運動，請商店停止使用塑膠袋。
campaign for office: The young lawyer quit her job to campaign for office, visiting markets and temples every day to meet voters.
那位年輕律師辭職去競選公職，每天走訪市場和廟宇與選民見面。
capture the moment: When the baby took her first steps, her father quickly grabbed his phone to capture the moment.
寶寶踏出第一步時，她爸爸迅速拿起手機捕捉這個瞬間。
capture one's imagination: Stories about space travel have captured my imagination since I was a small child.
從我很小的時候，太空旅行的故事就激發了我的想像。
capture the market: With low prices and good design, the company hopes to capture the market for electric scooters in Asia.
憑著低價和好設計，這家公司希望占領亞洲電動機車的市場。
capture attention: A good speech should capture attention in the first minute, or the audience will stop listening.
一場好的演講應該在第一分鐘就抓住注意，否則聽眾會不再聽。
capture the mood: The photographer managed to capture the mood of the rainy evening with soft lights and empty streets.
攝影師用柔和的燈光和空蕩的街道，成功呈現出那個雨夜的氛圍。
carry weight: Her opinion carries weight in the company because she has worked there for over twenty years.
她的意見在公司裡很有分量，因為她已經在那裡工作超過二十年了。
carry out a plan: The team needed more money and people to carry out a plan to clean up the whole beach.
這個團隊需要更多資金和人手來執行清理整片海灘的計畫。
carry on: Even though it started to rain, the band decided to carry on playing until the end of the concert.
儘管開始下雨，樂團仍決定繼續演奏到音樂會結束。
carry the day: The debate was close, but in the end the students' strong evidence carried the day.
辯論很接近，但最後學生們有力的證據讓他們獲勝。
carry a disease: Some mosquitoes carry a disease called dengue fever, so it is important to remove standing water.
有些蚊子帶原一種叫登革熱的疾病，所以清除積水很重要。
carry a risk: Every surgery carries a risk, so the doctor explained all the possible problems before the operation.
每個手術都帶有風險，所以醫生在手術前說明了所有可能的問題。
